cards.front: Which statement accurately describes the current AMFTRB National Examination structure?
cards.back:
A. The examination contains 180 multiple-choice items, each with four options and one correct answer; all items count, and candidates have four hours.

A. CORRECT. Correct. The current official structure is 180 objective multiple-choice items, four options per item, one correct answer, all items counted, and four hours of testing time.

cards.front: A candidate has answered 68 items after 90 minutes. Using the Workbook 1 flexible pacing method, which interpretation is MOST accurate?
